'''DeckTech tournament reports''' are the tournament reports players posted on DeckTech alongside its decklists, from August 1999 to 2002. DeckTech itself is gone; Stephen Skilton's archive keeps 1,406 of them under [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/tournament_reports/ Tournament Reports] (mirror: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/tournament_reports/ GitHub Pages]). The archive keeps each report's text, author and date, but its titles are URL slugs, so the titles here are rebuilt from them. Each report on this wiki has its own article, part of [[Tournament reports]].

== Reports on this wiki ==

823 of the archive's 1,406 reports have their own article so far (report text verbatim, plus the author's games and results). Sort by any column.
